03 / THE APPROACH

DON’T JUST RESET IT.
UNDERSTAND IT.

01 — OBSERVE

Start with the evidence.

Read the logs. Hear the user. Reproduce the behavior. A useful question beats a confident guess.

02 — ISOLATE

Follow the failure.

Separate the device, the identity, the application and the network. Find the boundary where things change.

03 — RESOLVE

Make the next time easier.

Restore service, document the fix and improve the repeatable process. The handoff is part of the work.
